 News › News News › CAT Admit Card 2026 Released! Direct Link to download hall ticket, exam date, timings CAT Admit Card 2026 Released! Direct Link to download hall ticket, exam date, timings
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Nov 6, 2026, 13:41 IST CAT 2026 Admit Card Out The CAT 2026 admit card is now RELEASED on the official website, iimcat.ac.in . IIM Indore released the CAT admit card 2026 on November 6, 2026 . Candidates can download it using their CAT registration number and password or date of birth. The CAT 2026 admit card is a mandatory document for entry into the examination centre and without it, candidates will not be allowed to appear for the CAT 2026 exam . CAT exam 2026 will be conducted on November 29, 2026. This article covers the latest updates, step-by-step download process, and key details about the CAT admit card. 
 Candidates can check the main pointers below to stay fully prepared.
 CAT Admit Card 2026 Download Link 
 The CAT 2026 admit card has been issued on November 6, 2025, at iimcat.ac.in . Candidates can download their admit card using their User ID and password. The CAT hall ticket includes important details such as the exam date, time, and test centre. Candidates are advised to download and verify all details on their admit card well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues before the CAT 2026 exam on November 29, 2026.
 How to download the CAT Hall Ticket 2026 ?
 Visit the IIMCAT Official Website.
 Click on the Registered Candidate Login link.
 Enter the CAT 2026 User ID and Password , then fill in the security captcha.
 Click on the Admit Card tab
 Download the PDF and take 2 to 3 clear printouts on A4 paper for exam day
 The CAT 2026 exam will be held on Sunday, November 29, 2026,across three distinct shifts. Candidates can check their assigned slot and download the hall ticket directly from the official website
 CAT 2026 slot timings
 Slot 1 (Morning Session): 8:30 am – 10:30 am
 Slot 2 (Afternoon Session): 12:30 pm – 2:30 pm
 Slot 3 (Evening Session): 4:30 pm – 6:30 pm
 CAT 2026 exam duration & pattern
 Total Duration: 120 minutes (2 hours)
 Sectional Time Limit: 40 minutes per section (Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension, Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative Aptitude)
 Reporting Time: Typically reported ~90 minutes before the exam begins (check your specific admit card for exact reporting and gate-closing times).
